title: Optimized concentration moment identity
statement: Let $k$ be a positive integer and let $t>0$. Set $q=t^{2/k}/e$, where $e=\exp(1)$. Then $\bigl((\sqrt q)^k/t\bigr)^q=\exp\bigl(-k t^{2/k}/(2e)\bigr)$.
replaced: Let $k>0$ be an integer and $t>0$, and put $q=t^{2/k}/e$. Then $((\sqrt q)^k/t)^q=\exp(-kt^{2/k}/(2e))$.
